passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Ray remembered Jennifer proudly showing him her third-grade report card and said she was “smiling and grinning.”

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Michael was already talking about Jennifer beginning school soon and how well she had done in third grade.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Jennifer Seen at Concrete Business: Former Short employee Ronnie Ray, owner of Rocky Mount Ready Mix, said he last saw Jennifer when Michael brought her with him to Ray’s concrete business on August 12, three days before the murders.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: According to Lemons, Bowman appeared angry and referred to a man he said owed him money.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Lemons later told investigators Bowman said words to the effect that “he would have to kill him.”

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: This conversation became significant after investigators learned Bowman left the area shortly after the Short family murders.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Garry Storm Bowman, a carpenter who had lived in the Mayodan, North Carolina area, allegedly asked his landlord Rick Lemons for help moving his mobile home.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: 11:13 p.m. – Circle C Convenience Store: Surveillance footage captured Jennifer Short inside the Circle C convenience store near her family’s home. The footage was recorded less than two days before Michael and Mary Short were discovered murdered, and Jennifer was reported missing.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The surveillance image provides one of the final known visual records of Jennifer before her disappearance.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Thompson stayed at a motel near the Short residence and returned after leaving Michael that evening.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Thompson told investigators that Michael, Mary and Jennifer were alive when he left the residence. Later accounts state that Jennifer had already gone to bed. Thompson would become one of the last known people to see the family before the murders.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Thompson and Michael had plans for the following morning. They were supposed to travel to Christiansburg, Virginia, to pick up a truck for Michael’s mobile-home moving business.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Evening: Michael Short spent part of the evening with his employee, Chris Thompson, working on a vehicle at the Short property.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: 10:51 p.m.: A Walmart receipt dated August 14, 2002, and timestamped 10:51 p.m. was recovered during the investigation of the Short residence. The receipt provides a documented transaction from the family’s final evening before Michael and Mary Short were murdered and Jennifer Short was abducted.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The Short family spent what would become their final evening at their Oak Level home.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Investigators believe the murders and Jennifer’s abduction occurred sometime between midnight on August 14 and approximately 9:00 a.m. on August 15, 2002.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: 11:05 p.m Michael, Mary, and Jennifer went through a Burger King drive-through in the Collinsville area late that night

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: At some point during the overnight or early morning hours, the person or persons responsible entered or gained access to the Short residence.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: An unidentified man was reportedly seen parked along U.S. Highway 220 near the Short home during the early morning hours. Investigators later sought to identify the man and the vehicle associated with the sighting.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The telephone line serving the Short residence was cut.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Michael Short was shot once in the head.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Mary Short was shot once in the head.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Investigators recovered two.22-caliber cartridge casings, one from Mary Short’s bed and another from the garage floor near Michael Short.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Jennifer Short disappeared from the residence during the same general period and was believed to have been abducted.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Authorities have never publicly established how long Jennifer remained alive after she was taken from the home.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Between 12:00 a.m. and approximately 9:00 a.m.: Someone entered or gained access to the Short residence.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Thompson had worked for Michael for approximately six months.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: He arrived in his pickup truck, honked the horn, and yelled, expecting Michael to come outside.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: When no one responded, Thompson entered the house.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Michael had a couch in the garage and sometimes slept there.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Thompson found Michael lying on the couch. As he approached, he realized Michael was not sleeping and appeared to have suffered a gunshot wound to the head.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The Roanoke Times reported: An August 17, 2002 Roanoke Times report specifically described Michael as naked when Thompson discovered him on the garage couch. This detail is not consistently reported in other accounts of the discovery.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Thompson contacted authorities.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Thompson contacted authorities.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: 9:00 a.m. Michael Short’s employee, Chris Thompson, arrived at the Short residence to meet Michael. The two planned to travel to Christiansburg, Virginia, to pick up a truck for Michael’s mobile-home moving business.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Wayne Davis, then a Henry County patrol deputy and now sheriff, was among the first officers to respond.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Deputies found Michael Short on a couch in the attached garage area of the residence. He had been shot once in the head.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Later reporting concerning the crime scene described Mary’s mattress as having been displaced by approximately two inches and her pillow as being on the bedroom floor.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: There was no indication in the publicly released evidence that Michael or Mary had engaged in an extended physical struggle with their killer.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Officers entered the residence. Mary Short was found dead in her bed. She also had been shot once in the head.
